messages:
alice: Heads-up — proposing a change to telemetry/event schema to replace the per-route quota fields (route_quota_type, route_quota_value) with a single quota_profile_id that points to a small denormalized table. This would let us evolve quota semantics (token vs request, burst windows) without changing event payloads or console queries. Thoughts?

ben: I like the indirection. Main concerns: query perf for high-cardinality route lookups and ensuring dashboards + billing don't break.

carmen: Agree. If we add quota_profile_id on the events table we need an index but avoid expanding row width too much. Also need a rollout path so old clients keep working.

alice: Proposal sketch: 1) add quota_profiles table (id, kind, config_json, effective_from) 2) add quota_profile_id (nullable) to events with a small FK-ish reference but no strict FK at first 3) dual-write (events + quota_profile_id) in server API under feature flag 4) nightly backfill to populate historical rows where possible 5) console reads route through adapter to join profile data for dashboards

evant: small nit: dual-write in API will need to resolve where to pick profile_id — routing policy or per-tenant override? We should decide precedence now.

alice: Good point — precedence: tenant override > route config > global default. We'll codify in routing code.

ben: For backfill approach: run an idempotent job that looks up most-recent quota profile effective at event_ts and write quota_profile_id. That keeps historical semantics. Watch out for long backfill time for 30+ days of telemetry. Might need chunking and rate limits.

carmen: SQL sketch for adding column and index: 
```sql
ALTER TABLE events ADD COLUMN quota_profile_id bigint NULL;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS events_quota_profile_idx ON events (quota_profile_id) WHERE quota_profile_id IS NOT NULL;
-- backfill pattern
UPDATE events e
SET quota_profile_id = qp.id
FROM LATERAL (SELECT id FROM quota_profiles qp WHERE qp.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND qp.effective_from <= e.event_ts ORDER BY qp.effective_from DESC LIMIT 1) qp
WHERE e.quota_profile_id IS NULL;
```

carmen: But that lateral may be heavy — prefer backfill that joins on partitioned snapshots per-tenant.

devex-lisa: Console UX note: dashboards currently surface route_quota_* fields in cost breakdowns. We need a transitional adapter in the Console that synthesizes the old fields from quota_profiles for a period. Devex wants a feature flag to flip to new UI once backfill reaches 99.9% coverage.

ben: Also telemetry ingestion: streaming pipeline needs to not explode on new column. Should be additive and default null. Confirmed with ingestion team?

alice: Reached out to eng-ml about memory impact; they said small. Ev's team to add index and partition planning.

infra-bot: Migration job queued: telemetry-backfill/quota-profile-2026-03 started (job id: mq-4832). Progress updates will post in #eng-platform-migrations.

evan: Monitoring plan: 1) backfill coverage gauge (percent rows with profile_id) 2) dashboard compatibility smoke tests (sample queries compare old vs synthesized fields) 3) query latency p95 for top-50 dashboard queries before/after index creation 4) billing diffs check (daily)

carmen: One more: we should avoid FK constraints initially to speed writes; validate referential integrity asynchronously.

alice: Sounds like next steps: write small RFC with above plan + migration runbook, add feature flag in API to enable quota_profile dual-write, schedule backfill in low-traffic windows, Console adapter for synthesized fields. I can draft RFC. Who can review before EOD?

ben: I'll take first pass on infra & perf implications.

carmen: I'll handle SQL/partition details and the backfill job ops.

devex-lisa: I'll mock the Console adapter and a toggle. Need example synthesized fields mapping from config_json.

alice: Thanks — I'll open the RFC and link here. If infra-bot posts any migration errors tag me. :thumbsup:
